A Roman copper alloy radiate of Gallienus (AD 253-268) VICTORIA AET reverse type depicting Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Mint of Rome, AD 260-268 (Reece period 13). Cunetio 1238. Obverse: Radiate bust right. Obverse legend: GALLIENVS [AVG]. Reverse: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Reverse legend: [V]ICTORIA AET. Dimensions: diameter: 19.75mm; weight: 2.51g.
